entries.reason: The locked public Core ABI exposes user-command callbacks that are not present in the frozen public UTS contract; the adapter implements and explicitly ignores them.
entries.probe: Native ABI inventory plus Public Android/iOS module compile
entries.removeWhen: The callbacks are removed from Core or added through an approved public contract change.

entries.reason: any and UTSJSONObject are isolated to native-call codec boundary files and converted immediately into concrete public models.
entries.probe: Concrete codec golden matrix and platform module compile
entries.removeWhen: Core exposes typed DTOs with identical missing/null semantics.

entries.reason: The locked iOS UTS compiler rejects break inside a braced switch case; generated cases use unique local names and no case block.
entries.probe: Generated concrete event switch in the iOS module compile
entries.removeWhen: A separately certified HBuilderX build accepts braced switch cases on all target platforms.

entries.reason: The locked Android UTS compiler lowers typed JSON.parseObject/parseArray calls through UTSAndroid and requires that named platform symbol in every source file using the typed parser.
entries.probe: Concrete string-array and send-progress JSON codecs in the Android module compile
entries.removeWhen: A separately certified HBuilderX build resolves typed JSON helpers without a file-local UTSAndroid import.

entries.reason: The locked Core headers expose nullable listener setters, but the Go implementation passes reflect.ValueOf(listener) to Call; a null listener becomes a zero reflect.Value and panics. Drivers invalidate the epoch, retire local listener references, and let Core unInit release its listener state instead of calling setters with null.
entries.probe: Android custom-base lifecycle regression reproduces reflect: Call using zero Value argument before the workaround and completes unInit without SIGABRT after it; iOS custom-base lifecycle regression plus static Driver invariant
entries.removeWhen: A locked Core build accepts null listener setters on Android and iOS and passes the lifecycle probe twice on arm64 devices.

entries.reason: The locked Public Core can run AddBlack's direct full blacklist sync concurrently with the BlackAdded notification sync. Both paths can observe the same missing local row and attempt to insert it, producing an intermittent unique-key failure.
entries.probe: Locked Core source-path concurrency review plus repeated Public iOS custom-base runtime reproduction; the SDK runner retains the failure without a skip or waiver.
entries.removeWhen: A replacement locked Public Core serializes both blacklist sync paths and the full Public friend suite passes without the duplicate-row failure on Android and iOS.

entries.reason: The locked Public Core group full-sync path inserts server pages directly into local_groups and falls back to one-by-one Create operations without deduplicating or upserting group IDs. A duplicate group identity therefore aborts synchronization with a local_groups.group_id unique-key failure.
entries.probe: Locked Core FullSync, FetchAndInsertPagedData, and group database insertion source review plus a clean Public iOS custom-base event-delivery reproduction; the SDK runner retained the exact Core failure without a skip or waiver.
entries.removeWhen: A replacement locked Public Core makes group full sync idempotent for duplicate group identities and the Public event-delivery suite passes repeatedly on Android and iOS.
